output.arguments:
{"code":"def transform(grid):
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]
    pts=[]
    for r,row in enumerate(g):
        for c,v in enumerate(row):
            if v: pts.append((r,c,v))
    if len(pts)!=3: return g
    # right angle is the point sharing row with one and column with another
    R=None; A=None; B=None
    for p in pts:
        others=[q for q in pts if q!=p]
        if others[0][0]==p[0] and others[1][1]==p[1] or others[1][0]==p[0] and others[0][1]==p[1]:
            R=p; A=others[0] if others[0][0]==p[0] else others[1]; B=others[1] if A==others[0] else others[0]; break
    if R is None:return g
    # inner right angle three cells toward the opposite corner
    dr=1 if A[0]>R[0] else -1 if A[0]<R[0] else 0
    dc=1 if B[1]>R[1] else -1 if B[1]<R[1] else 0
    ir,ic=R[0]+3*dr, R[1]+3*dc
    # vertices along respective legs, inward/outward from inner right angle toward R? inner legs extend toward A/B direction
    # A is row-changing? assign using actual directions
    for p in pts:
        if p[0]==R[0]: # horizontal vertex
            d=1 if p[1]>R[1] else -1
            x=(ir,ic+2*d); val=p[2]
        elif p[1]==R[1]:
            d=1 if p[0]>R[0] else -1
            x=(ir+2*d,ic); val=p[2]
        else: continue
        if 0<=x[0]<len(g) and 0<=x[1]<len(g[0]):g[x[0]][x[1]]=val
    if 0<=ir<len(g) and 0<=ic<len(g[0]): g[ir][ic]=5
    return g"}
